514e3938bc29: Align a phrase (merge and split cards) · translationCore 4 Help
c927f7073553: Use a phrase card when two or more source words become one word in your language, or a phrase translates a phrase.
c9202bd74f60: In Align, drag a word card onto the card next to it. The tooltip says "Drag onto another word card to merge them into a phrase."
a6977e999162: The two cards become one phrase card.
e4f9c5b57ad8: Place your word or words under the phrase card.
fa040e76edd1: To undo, click SPLIT on the phrase card.
1dc34f17a71b: Merge only neighbouring words that belong together.
f6cb843af438: If you had already placed words under the phrase card, check where they are after SPLIT. Click a misplaced word to send it back to the bank, then place it under the right card.
